subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve compact display, related fixes kept that behavior, and changing it affects UX, privacy, docs, and possible configuration surface.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display for true home-contained paths while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable rewrites.

options.title: Switch Default To Full Paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full absolute paths everywhere and update prompts, docs, and regression tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep compact display by default but add a documented opt-in mode for users who need full absolute paths in responses and tool displays.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display for true home-contained paths while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: The current display contract traces back to the central home-shortening helper he introduced, and the remaining decision is product direction rather than a narrow code repair.
